{"result":"{\"result\":\" 1\\t# ⚗️ Crucible\\n 2\\t\\n 3\\t[![CI](https://github.com/Mootikins/crucible/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Mootikins/crucible/actions/workflows/ci.yml)\\n 4\\t[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT%2FApache--2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE-MIT)\\n 5\\t[![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-mootikins.github.io%2Fcrucible-blue)](https://mootikins.github.io/crucible/)\\n 6\\t\\n 7\\t**A knowledge-grounded agent runtime. Agents that draw from a knowledge graph make better decisions.**\\n 8\\t\\n 9\\tLocal-first. No cloud. No lock-in. Your conversations, notes, and wikilinks form a knowledge graph that agents draw from and contribute to — all as markdown files you own.\\n 10\\t\\n 11\\t

\\n 12\\t \\n 13\\t

\\n 14\\t\\n 15\\t> **Early Development**: APIs and storage formats may change. Contributions welcome!\\n 16\\t\\n 17\\t## What Makes Crucible Different\\n 18\\t\\n 19\\tMemory and knowledge are too fundamental to be an afterthought. Most AI tools treat conversations as disposable — Crucible makes them the foundation.\\n 20\\t\\n 21\\t- **Knowledge-grounded agents.** Precognition auto-injects relevant context from your knowledge graph before each LLM turn. Block-level embeddings power semantic search at paragraph granularity. The more you use it, the smarter your agents get.\\n 22\\t- **Sessions are notes.** Every chat saves as markdown in your kiln. Search them, link them with wikilinks, version them in git. Conversations become permanent, connectable knowledge.\\n 23\\t- **Neovim-like architecture.** Lua/Fennel plugins, TUI-first, headless daemon with RPC. Most behaviors beyond the knowledge core can be scripted.\\n 24\\t- **Bring any LLM.** Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, local GGUF models. Swap freely.\\n 25\\t- **Plaintext first.** No proprietary formats. Files are the source of truth. The database is optional acceleration.\\n 26\\t\\n 27\\t## How It Compares\\n 28\\t\\n 29\\t| | Crucible | ChatGPT | Obsidian + AI | OpenClaw |\\n 30\\t|---|---|---|---|---|\\n 31\\t| Local-first | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |\\n 32\\t| Sessions as markdown | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |\\n 33\\t| Knowledge graph | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |\\n 34\\t| Bring your own LLM | ✅ | ❌ | Partial | ✅ |\\n 35\\t| Plugin system | ✅ Lua/Fennel | ❌ | ✅ JS | ✅ TS |\\n 36\\t| MCP server | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |\\n 37\\t| Semantic search | ✅ Block-level | ❌ | Plugin | ❌ |\\n 38\\t| Setup time | ~2 min | 0 | ~5 min | 2-7 hrs |\\n 39\\t\\n 40\\t## Install\\n 41\\t\\n 42\\t**Pre-built binaries** (Linux x86_64/aarch64, macOS Apple Silicon):\\n 43\\t\\n 44\\t```bash\\n 45\\tcurl -fsSL https://github.com/Mootikins/crucible/releases/latest/download/crucible-cli-installer.sh | sh\\n 46\\t```\\n 47\\t\\n 48\\t**From source:**\\n 49\\t\\n 50\\t```bash\\n 51\\tcargo install --git https://github.com/Mootikins/crucible.git crucible-cli\\n 52\\t```\\n 53\\t\\n 54\\t## Quick Start\\n 55\\t\\n 56\\t```bash\\n 57\\t# Start a chat session\\n 58\\tcru chat\\n 59\\t\\n 60\\t# Chat with Claude Code, enriched by your knowledge base\\n 61\\tcru chat -a claude\\n 62\\t\\n 63\\t# Or start the MCP server for Claude/GPT integration\\n 64\\tcru mcp\\n 65\\t```\\n 66\\t\\n 67\\tFirst run prompts for a kiln path and detects available LLM providers. A background daemon auto-spawns via `cru daemon serve` to manage session state, file watching, and multi-session support. It communicates over a Unix socket and restarts automatically if stopped.\\n 68\\t\\n 69\\t**In a chat session:**\\n 70\\t- Type naturally, the agent responds with access to your knowledge base\\n 71\\t- `/search query` injects relevant notes into context\\n 72\\t- `:model`, `:set`, `:export` for REPL commands\\n 73\\t- `BackTab` cycles modes: Normal → Plan → Auto\\n 74\\t\\n 75\\t

\\n 76\\t \\n 77\\t

\\n 78\\t\\n 79\\t## Features\\n 80\\t\\n 81\\t### Agent Chat\\n 82\\t\\n 83\\tInteractive conversations with full session persistence. The TUI supports streaming markdown, tool calls, and multi-turn context. Sessions save as markdown files organized by workspace.\\n 84\\t\\n 85\\t### Knowledge Graph\\n 86\\t\\n 87\\tWikilinks (`[[Note Name]]`) define your graph. No extraction step, no special syntax beyond what you'd write naturally. Query by graph traversal, semantic similarity, tags, or full-text search.\\n 88\\t\\n 89\\t### MCP Server\\n 90\\t\\n 91\\tExpose your knowledge base to any MCP-compatible AI (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, GPT, local models):\\n 92\\t\\n 93\\t```bash\\n 94\\tcru mcp\\n 95\\t```\\n 96\\t\\n 97\\tTools include `semantic_search`, `create_note`, `get_outlinks`, `get_inlinks`, and more.\\n 98\\t\\n 99\\t### Agent Integration (ACP)\\n 100\\t\\n 101\\tCrucible can spawn and orchestrate external AI agents through the [Agent Context Protocol](https://agentcontextprotocol.org/). Your agent gets full access to Crucible's knowledge graph, semantic search, and tools.\\n 102\\t\\n 103\\t```bash\\n 104\\t# Use Claude Code with your knowledge base\\n 105\\tcru chat -a claude\\n 106\\t\\n 107\\t# Use OpenCode\\n 108\\tcru chat -a opencode\\n 109\\t\\n 110\\t# Use Gemini CLI\\n 111\\tcru chat -a gemini\\n 112\\t```\\n 113\\t\\n 114\\tBuilt-in agents (auto-discovered if installed):\\n 115\\t\\n 116\\t| Agent | Command | Install |\\n 117\\t|-------|---------|---------|\\n 118\\t| opencode | `opencode` | `go install github.com/grafana/opencode@latest` |\\n 119\\t| claude | `npx @zed-industries/claude-agent-acp` | `npm install -g @zed-industries/claude-agent-acp` |\\n 120\\t| gemini | `gemini` | `npm install -g gemini-cli` |\\n 121\\t| codex | `npx @zed-industries/codex-acp` | `npm install -g @zed-industries/codex-acp` |\\n 122\\t| cursor | `cursor-acp` | `npm install -g cursor-acp` |\\n 123\\t\\n 124\\tAgents can delegate tasks to each other. An ACP agent like Claude can hand off work to Cursor or OpenCode mid-conversation using the `delegate_session` tool, then incorporate the results. Delegation works both directions: internal agents can delegate to ACP agents, and ACP agents can delegate to other ACP agents.\\n 125\\t\\n 126\\tCustom profiles go in `crucible.toml`:\\n 127\\t\\n 128\\t```toml\\n 129\\t[acp.agents.my-claude]\\n 130\\textends = \\\"claude\\\"\\n 131\\tenv = { ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = \\\"http://localhost:4000\\\" }\\n 132\\t```\\n 133\\t\\n 134\\tThen: `cru chat -a my-claude`\\n 135\\t\\n 136\\t### Lua Plugins\\n 137\\t\\n 138\\tDrop `.lua` or `.fnl` files into `~/.config/crucible/plugins/` or your kiln's `plugins/` directory:\\n 139\\t\\n 140\\t```lua\\n 141\\t-- @tool name=\\\"summarize\\\" description=\\\"Summarize notes matching query\\\"\\n 142\\t-- @param query string \\\"Search query\\\"\\n 143\\tfunction summarize(args)\\n 144\\t local results = crucible.search(args.query)\\n 145\\t return { summary = \\\"Found \\\" .. #results .. \\\" notes\\\" }\\n 146\\tend\\n 147\\t```\\n 148\\t\\n 149\\tSee the [plugin guide](./docs/Help/Concepts/Scripting%20Languages.md) for the full API.\\n 150\\t\\n 151\\t## Documentation\\n 152\\t\\n 153\\t- **[Documentation Site](https://mootikins.github.io/crucible/)** — searchable, organized reference\\n 154\\t- **[docs/](./docs/)** is both the user guide and a working example kiln (155 interlinked notes)\\n 155\\t- **[AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md)** covers architecture and AI agent instructions\\n 156\\t\\n 157\\t## Command Reference\\n 158\\t\\n 159\\t| Command | Alias | Description |\\n 160\\t|---------|-------|-------------|\\n 161\\t| `cru chat` | `c` | Interactive AI chat with session persistence |\\n 162\\t| `cru chat -a ` | | Use an ACP agent (claude, opencode, gemini, etc.) |\\n 163\\t| `cru chat --resume ` | | Resume a previous session |\\n 164\\t| `cru mcp` | | Start MCP server for external AI agents |\\n 165\\t| `cru process` | `p` | Parse, enrich, and store markdown files |\\n 166\\t| `cru init` | `i` | Initialize a new kiln (workspace) |\\n 167\\t| `cru session create` | | Create a new session (add `--agent ` for ACP) |\\n 168\\t| `cru session list` | `s` | List sessions (live by default, `--all` includes persisted) |\\n 169\\t| `cru session show ` | | Show session details (daemon first, file fallback) |\\n 170\\t| `cru session open ` | | Open a previous session in the TUI |\\n 171\\t| `cru session send \\\"msg\\\"` | | Send a message and stream the response |\\n 172\\t| `cru session configure ` | | Set agent backend (provider, model, endpoint) |\\n 173\\t| `cru session pause ` | | Pause a running daemon session |\\n 174\\t| `cru session resume ` | | Resume a paused daemon session |\\n 175\\t| `cru session end ` | | End a daemon session |\\n 176\\t| `cru session export ` | | Export session to markdown |\\n content integrity |\\n 190\\t| `cru auth login` | | Store LLM provider API key |\\n 191\\t\\n 192\\tRun `cru --help` for full options.\\n 193\\t\\n 194\\t## Roadmap\\n 195\\t\\n 196\\t- [x] TUI chat I'll explore the repository to understand what it contains.## Crucible

**Crucible** is a **knowledge-grounded agent runtime** — a local-first system where AI agents draw from and contribute to a personal knowledge graph built from your notes, conversations, and wikilinks.

### Key Concepts

| Concept | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Kiln** | A content directory storing notes, sessions, and knowledge (plaintext markdown) |
| **Precognition** | Auto-injects relevant context from your knowledge graph before each LLM turn |
| **Sessions as Notes** | Every chat saves as markdown — searchable, linkable, versionable in git |
| **MCP Server** | Exposes knowledge tools to Claude/GPT/local models |
| **ACP** | Agent Context Protocol — spawn Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, etc. through Crucible |

### Architecture

It's a **Rust workspace** with 11 crates:

| Crate | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `crucible-core` | Domain logic, traits, parser types |
| `crucible-cli` | Terminal UI, REPL, commands |
| `crucible-daemon` | Background daemon with RPC (Unix socket), session management, file watching |
| `crucible-llm` | LLM/embedding backends (Ollama, OpenAI, FastEmbed) |
| `crucible-sqlite` | SQLite storage |
| `crucible-lance` | LanceDB vector storage |
| `crucible-lua` | Lua/Fennel plugin system |
| `crucible-web` | Browser chat UI (SolidJS + Axum) |
| `crucible-acp` | Agent Context Protocol support |
| `crucible-oil` | Terminal rendering primitives |

### Notable Features

- **Neovim-like**: TUI-first, headless daemon with RPC, Lua/Fennel plugins
- **Plaintext-first**: Markdown files are the source of truth; no proprietary formats
- **Block-level semantic search**: Embeddings at paragraph granularity
- **Multi-agent orchestration**: Agents can delegate to each other via ACP

### Tech Stack

- **Rust 1.75+** with Tokio async runtime
- **Storage**: SQLite + LanceDB (vector embeddings)
- **Protocol**: JSON-RPC 2.0 over Unix socket
- **Frontend**: Ratatmoi (TUI), SolidJS (web)
- **Plugins**: Lua 5.4 via mlua
